Online course

Design agent systems you can trust, and rules a coding agent cannot quietly break.

Sixteen lessons on choosing between workflows and agents, writing tools as contracts, setting autonomy and approval, giving coding agents architecture knowledge they can read, and turning rules into checks. Each lesson has four slides you control, a field guide, a worked case, three recall questions and a lab. Across the sixteen labs you build one agent system design, with the rules and checks that keep an agent inside it.

Start the free lessons Get the full course I already have a code

This is self-study: slides, a field guide, a worked case and a lab for every lesson, marked against a rubric you apply yourself. Its topics are informed by the public iSAQB AGENTA curriculum, but it is not AGENTA training, it gives no iSAQB credit and it is not an accredited qualification. Intellica is not an iSAQB accredited training provider. Legal topics are orientation, not legal advice. Facts were read on the dates shown in each lesson; research cited is early and mostly preprints.

03How it teaches

Built from how people learn

Short lessons you control

Four focused slides a lesson, each with a transcript. Move at your own pace and go back whenever you like.

One growing design

After every lesson a lab asks you to produce real work for your own agent system: shape decision, tool contracts, approvals, memory, rules, checks, evaluation, governance. The sixteen answers join into one design you download at the end.

Rules with checks

You write architecture rules in a form an agent can read, and every rule must name the test that verifies it or the person who reviews it. A rules checker tells you which rules are finished.

Built on current sources

The lessons follow the seven topics of the iSAQB AGENTA curriculum (2026.1) and the AI chapter of the 2027.1 Foundation release candidate, and cite 2026 research with its limits stated.

Practice tools you can run

A rules checker and a tool contract checker run in your browser. They check structure, not wisdom, and say so.

Mark your own work

Each lab has a model solution and a four-criterion rubric. Score yourself 0, 1 or 2 on each, then close the gaps.

Pause and recall

Three questions at the end of each lesson, with the reason for each answer. Your progress is stored in this browser only.

Retrieval practice and spacing are among the best-studied learning techniques, so each lesson ends by asking what you remember before it shows you.

    06Questions

    Before you decide

    Who is this for?

    Developers and architects who add AI agents to products, or who let coding agents change a codebase, and need to decide how much to trust them and how to stop them breaking the design.

    Do I need Level 3, Quality, Decisions and Evaluation?

    No, but you should be comfortable with quality goals, scenarios and decision records. The lab builds on a system you can describe in detail.

    Is this iSAQB AGENTA training?

    No. It covers similar topics but it is independent self-study. It gives no iSAQB credit, and only iSAQB accredited providers can teach AGENTA for credit. Intellica is not one.

    Do I need to write code?

    You will write rules, contracts and plans. For the check-writing lab you describe real tests; a short script or configuration in your own language is best, but the course does not require a particular language.

    How do I get access?

    Pay by bank deposit from the buy button on this page, then upload a photo of the receipt. If the automatic check reads it cleanly, your course opens at once. If it cannot read the receipt, your course still opens at once as provisional access and the owner is told to check it against the bank statement; if the payment cannot be confirmed, access is closed again. Your access code is a decryption key and cannot be recalled once issued, so keep it private.

    Can I share my code?

    Please do not. The code is personal and your name appears on every lesson.

    What about refunds?

    Free lessons come first, so you can try before you pay. You can ask for a refund within 7 days of payment by WhatsApp, saying why, and we repay the account you paid from within 10 business days. After a refund your access code is withdrawn and you agree to stop using the course. No refund once you have claimed a certificate. If the course does not work as described and we cannot fix it, you get a full refund even after 7 days.
